$description: Folio design tokens shared by light and dark mode. The only source of visual values (CLAUDE.md section 5). CSS name = "--" + path joined with "-".

sans.$description: UI text. Microsoft YaHei UI covers Chinese file names and content.

body.$description: Default UI text, tree rows, dialog body (density 4B).

label.$description: Field labels and card descriptions in settings; the course name after the course code in tree rows (26C).

small.$description: Toolbar controls, secondary text, group headers.

heading.$description: Panel titles (Library, Changes, History) and settings card titles.

display.$description: Titles of the welcome screen, the first-run steps and full-window states such as "Can’t find your library".

badge.$description: Three-letter course badge text at 22 px; three capitals of a course code fit (Sirui, 2026-10-03).

badge-compact.$description: Course badge text at 20 px (narrow window).

regular.$description: Body text, descriptions, and the course name after a course code.

strong.$description: Titles, course codes, file names in path+name pairs, selected nav items.

badge.$description: Course badge letters, tightened so three capitals fit (COM, MGT, WGS).

body.$description: Default line height of UI text.

diff.$description: Diff lines: 22 px lines at 12.5 px.

4.$description: Spacing step, 4 px: icon-to-label gaps in small controls.

6.$description: Spacing step, 6 px: tree panel padding.

8.$description: Spacing step, 8 px: the default gap between items in a row; the panel gap.

10.$description: Spacing step, 10 px: gap between rail buttons, toolbar items and commit-lane cards.

12.$description: Spacing step, 12 px: panel padding and commit-lane padding.

14.$description: Spacing step, 14 px: dot-grid pitch of empty states; padding of the course file grid.

16.$description: Spacing step, 16 px: tree indent per level; settings card padding (block).

18.$description: Spacing step, 18 px: settings card padding (inline).

32.$description: Spacing step, 32 px: between the sections of first-run steps and full-window states.

panel-gap.$description: Gap between panels and between the panels and the window edge.

row.$description: Tree rows, change rows, history file rows, settings split rows use their own padding.

panel-header.$description: Panel header height (Library, Changes, History, preview header).

toolbar.$description: Toolbar row below the title bar (18C3: no menu bar).

narrow-bar.$description: Single top bar in windows narrower than size.narrow-breakpoint.

control.$description: Toolbar controls: sync chip, Sync button, semester, search.

control-compact.$description: Icon buttons, narrow-bar controls, small outline buttons.

dialog-control.$description: Inputs and field buttons in settings dialogs.

chip.$description: Tag filter chips and tag chips in the preview header.

icon.$description: Row icons, file-type icons, status icons.

icon-small.$description: Icons in chips, small buttons and drag grips.

status-icon.$description: Change status icon (20A outlined square + glyph).

badge.$description: Course badge (23A). Below 20 px the badge shows colour only.

badge-compact.$description: Course badge in the narrow window; its letters use font.size.badge-compact.

badge-mini.$description: Course badge below 20 px (in a 16 px box): a square in the dot colour, no text (58 %, 23A).

tag-dot.$description: Tag dots in rows, chips and filters.

tag-dot-gap.$description: Between the tag dots of a row or tile (app-shell §5).

selection-bar-width.$description: Accent bar on the left edge of the selected row, rail item and settings nav item.

rail-compact.$description: Rail width in the narrow window.

rail-button.$description: Square rail buttons (Library, Changes, History, settings).

rail-button-compact.$description: Rail buttons in the narrow window.

avatar.$description: Avatar at the bottom of the rail.

library-panel.$description: Library panel width (tag filters and tree).

commit-lane.$description: Commit lane width, next to the changes list.

history-panel.$description: Default width; the user can drag between history-panel-min and history-panel-max (19C).

history-panel-min.$description: Narrowest width the history panel can be dragged to.

history-panel-max.$description: Widest width the history panel can be dragged to.

history-time-column.$description: Right-aligned time column of history entries.

resize-handle.$description: Hit area of the history resize handle, centred on the gap between panels.

search-dialog-top.$description: The search dialog's distance from the top of the window (app-shell §8).

narrow-breakpoint.$description: Below this window width the narrow layout (16A) applies.

icon-large.$description: Icons in state tiles (empty and error states).

state-tile.$description: Rounded tile behind the icon of empty states, error states and first-run choices.

menu-item.$description: Items of context menus and popover menus.

menu-min-width.$description: Narrowest context menu; menus grow with their longest label.

menu-max-width.$description: Widest context menu; longer labels truncate and keep a tooltip.

toast.$description: Toast width. Toasts stack in the bottom-right corner, above the panels.

progress-bar.$description: Height of progress bars: activity popover, first run, import toasts.

activity-popover.$description: Width of the activity popover (jobs and problems).

dialog-small.$description: Confirmation dialogs, such as deleting a course.

problems-dialog-height.$description: Problems dialog height; its list scrolls.

first-run-content.$description: Content column of the welcome screen, the first-run steps and full-window states.

first-run-top.$description: Distance from the title bar to a first-run step page (first-run §4.1).

first-run-inset.$description: Welcome screen padding at top and bottom; distance from the title bar to the taller step pages (first-run §3, §4.1).

welcome-inset-start.$description: Welcome screen padding on the left (first-run §3).

welcome-inset-end.$description: Welcome screen padding on the right (first-run §3).

welcome-gap.$description: Gap between the welcome screen's two columns (first-run §3).

welcome-column.$description: The welcome screen's left column: title and the two choices (first-run §3).

welcome-illustration-width.$description: The desk illustration on the welcome screen's right panel (first-run §3).

welcome-illustration-height.$description: The desk illustration on the welcome screen's right panel (first-run §3).

app-icon-large.$description: The app icon above the welcome title (first-run §3).

folder-tile.$description: The folder tile of a first-run folder card (first-run §4.1).

first-run-field.$description: The semester field and the semester select of first-run step 2 (first-run §5).

course-code-field.$description: The course code input of a course row (first-run §5.1).

colour-button.$description: Width of a course row's colour button (first-run §5.1).

colour-dot.$description: The colour dot in a course row's colour button (first-run §5.1).

icon-tiny.$description: The chevron of a course row's colour button (first-run §5.1).

swatch.$description: A swatch button in the colour popover (first-run §5.1).

swatch-dot.$description: The dot inside a colour popover swatch (first-run §5.1).

map-role-column.$description: The role column of the take-over map (first-run §4.2).

unavailable-offset.$description: Extra space below the centred column of the library-unavailable screen (first-run §7).

state-block-width.$description: Width of a state block centred in the preview (library-actions §2.5).

state-block-offset.$description: Distance from the top of the tree area to a state block in the tree (library-actions §2.5).

callout-max-width.$description: Largest width of a callout under a field in a row (library-actions §2.2).

title-bar-mark.$description: Box of the 16 px app mark at the left of the 32 px title bar (app-shell §3).

key-cap.$description: Height of key caps such as "Ctrl K" in the search button.

target-min.$description: Smallest hit target (WCAG 2.5.8): toast buttons, cancel buttons, checkbox and radio hit areas.

rail-indicator.$description: Height of the selection bar at the window's left edge beside the active rail button.

selection-bar-inset.$description: Top and bottom inset of the selection bar on selected rows and nav items (app-shell §10).

status-dot.$description: The warning dot on the activity button while jobs run and problems remain.

grid-tile-min.$description: Smallest width of a tile in the grid of a course or folder (app-shell §5).

grid-tile.$description: Height of a grid tile: padding, thumbnail area, name line and border (app-shell §5).

grid-thumbnail.$description: Height of a grid tile's thumbnail area (app-shell §5).

icon-thumbnail.$description: The file-type icon in a tile's thumbnail area when the file has no thumbnail.

illustration-width.$description: Width of the desk illustration of the empty preview (app-shell 9C).

illustration-height.$description: Height of the desk illustration of the empty preview (app-shell 9C).

document.$description: Width of a Markdown note's text column in the preview (app-shell §5).

document-padding-block.$description: Space above and below a Markdown note in the preview (app-shell §5).

document-padding-inline.$description: Space left and right of a Markdown note in the preview (app-shell §5).

code-gutter.$description: The line-number column of text and code previews.

icon-card.$description: The file-type icon of the preview card for files Folio does not show (app-shell §5).

page-pill.$description: Height of the PDF preview's page and zoom pill ("1 / 4 · 100%").

folder-picker.$description: Largest height of the folder picker's tree before it scrolls (library-actions §2.9).

tree-separator.$description: Height of the Library tree's separator row: space.6 above and below a border.width line (app-shell §5).

switch-knob.$description: Diameter of a switch knob: the track height less 3 px on each side.

checkbox.$description: A checkbox square; its hit area is size.target-min (library-actions §12).

settings-nav-item.$description: Height of a settings navigation item (app-shell §9).

settings-code-column.$description: Width of the course code column in Settings → Courses (app-shell §9).

settings-rules.$description: Minimum height of the ignore rules text area in Library settings.

diff-line-number.$description: Each of the two line-number columns of a diff (workspace-history handoff §6.3).

diff-sign.$description: The column of a diff line that holds its + or − sign.

diff-fold.$description: Height of the row that stands for unchanged lines a diff leaves out ("Show 7 unchanged lines").

diff-summary.$description: Height of the strip under a diff header: what is compared, the counts and the change navigation.

diff-change-bar.$description: Width of the accent bar at the left edge of the current change's lines (workspace-history handoff §6.3).

diff-mark-offset.$description: How far below the baseline the underline of a changed word sits (workspace-history handoff §6.4).

diff-tags-label.$description: Label column of a diff's tags block: "Added", "Removed", "Now" (workspace-history handoff §6.8).

diff-compact-pane.$description: Below this pane width the diff header moves "Changes | This version" and Restore into More (workspace-history handoff §2.2).

composer-summary.$description: Height of the commit message summary field in the commit box.

commit-bar-field.$description: Height of the summary field and its buttons in the narrow window's commit bar (decision 30B).

changes-group-header.$description: Height of the "Tags and settings" header row at the end of the changes list (workspace-history handoff §3.3).

changes-tag.$description: Height of the "Tags" tag after the path of a tag change in the changes list (workspace-history handoff §3.3).

commit-box-footer.$description: Height of the commit box's footer: the AI status on the left, the message button on the right (workspace-history handoff §4.1).

commit-bar-overlay.$description: Window height below which the narrow commit bar's description opens over the list's lower half instead of shrinking the list below two rows (workspace-history handoff §4.7, 500 × 320).

changes-narrow-breakpoint.$description: Below this window width the Changes view uses its narrow layout, the diff over the list (workspace-history handoff §2.1 as built): its fixed list and commit lane would leave the diff about 300 px or less. The shell and the other views keep size.narrow-breakpoint.

card-tile.$description: The sunken tile before a commit-lane card's title: "Not synced" (workspace-history handoff §5).

lane-node.$description: A commit's dot on the "Not synced" card's lane (workspace-history handoff §5).

first-commit-progress.$description: Width of the first commit's progress bar in its state block (workspace-history handoff §10).

folder-card.$description: Height of a folder card in a course or folder grid (decision 35A).

folder-card-min.$description: Smallest width of a folder card; the grid fits as many as this allows.

grid-group-label.$description: Height of the "Folders" and "Files" label rows in a course or folder grid (decision 35A): one line of font.size.small.

icon-folder-card.$description: The folder icon of a folder card (decision 35A).

control.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects, the sync chip and file cards.

row.$description: Tree rows, list rows and settings navigation items.

badge-mini.$description: The colour square of a course badge below 20 px.

pill.$description: Count pills, the "Not synced" pill and the "Your commit goes here" pill.

key-cap.$description: Key caps such as "Ctrl K" and "Esc".

indicator.$description: Outer corners of selection bars: rows, the rail's edge bar, settings nav items.

row-inset.$description: What sits 1 px inside a row: the inline name field, a drop target's outline, a tile's thumbnail area (library-actions §3, §7.1).

diff-emphasis.$description: Corners of the emphasis behind a changed word in a diff line (workspace-history handoff §6.4).

badge.$description: Course badge border, in the badge tint (app-shell §10).

stroke-width.$description: Stroke of the Lucide line icons on their 24-unit grid, as drawn on the canvas.

offset.$description: Keyboard focus outline offset; rows and list items use it inset (negative).

height.$description: Keeps the maximize button inside the top 48 px for the snap layouts overlay (ADR-0001).

font-size.$description: The word "Folio" in the title bar.

button-width.$description: Minimize, maximize and close; the maximize button sits 46-92 px from the right edge.

base.$description: Dialogs, search, narrow preview overlay (fade and a 4 px rise).

spin.$description: One turn of a spinner. 0 under reduced motion, so spinners stand still.

indeterminate.$description: One sweep of an indeterminate progress bar. 0 under reduced motion, so the bar shows a still segment.

standard.$description: Entering and moving: dialogs, search, the narrow preview.

resize-handle.$description: History resize handle, above the panels.

drop-target.$description: Drop target outline and message while files are dragged over the window; below search and dialogs.

menu.$description: Context menus and popovers, above dialogs so a dialog’s own menus show.

tooltip.$description: Tooltips, above everything they can describe, toasts included.

disabled.$description: A check box that cannot change now, such as a change that is not on this computer yet (workspace-history handoff §3.4).

busy.$description: The changes list's check boxes (each row's, each course header's and the header's select-all) while a commit runs, and the header check box when there is nothing to include; the rows themselves keep full contrast (workspace-history handoff §3.1, §3.8 as built).

shortcut-hint.$description: The "Ctrl+Enter" hint on the commit button (workspace-history handoff decision 36: 4.12:1 on the light accent fill, an accepted exception).
